title: Multiplicativity of the Kronecker Symbol (First Argument)
description: Proves that the Kronecker symbol is completely multiplicative in the first argument: (ab/n) = (a/n)(b/n) for all integers with ab != 0. Uses case analysis on n with kronecker0 and kroneckerNeg1 multiplicativity for special cases, and Jacobi symbol multiplicativity for the general case.

mainTheorems.name: kronecker_mul_left_proved
mainTheorems.statement: kronecker (a * b) n = kronecker a n * kronecker b n
mainTheorems.description: Complete multiplicativity of the Kronecker symbol in the first argument, for nonzero a*b.

mainTheorems.name: kronecker0_mul_of_ne_zero
mainTheorems.statement: kronecker0 (a * b) = kronecker0 a * kronecker0 b
mainTheorems.description: Multiplicativity of kronecker0 (the unit character at modulus 0).

mainTheorems.name: kroneckerNeg1_mul_of_ne_zero
mainTheorems.statement: kroneckerNeg1 (a * b) = kroneckerNeg1 a * kroneckerNeg1 b
mainTheorems.description: Multiplicativity of kroneckerNeg1 (the sign character at modulus -1).

overview.text: Proves the Kronecker symbol is completely multiplicative in the first argument, handling the Kronecker extension to moduli 0, -1, 1, and general n separately.
overview.proofStrategy: Case analysis on n. For n=0: unit character multiplicativity. For n=-1: sign character multiplicativity (sgn(ab) = sgn(a)sgn(b)). For n=1: trivial. For general n: combine sign character multiplicativity with Jacobi symbol mul_left from Mathlib.
